dataSources.name: Backend bounds and estimator semantics
dataSources.sourceContract: Server validates confirmation, positive vehicle, allowed intervention/metric, ordered nonoverlapping 24-hour-to-365-day windows and one-minute future tolerance. It reads baseline/treatment historical aggregates and persists an estimate. At least five samples each and known metric values are required; low/unknown confounder coverage or unsuitable ambient comparison yields non_causal. Signed effect is treatment minus baseline. Wire fields are Wh/m, m/s and percentage/percentage-point values.
